'''Lika''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] who was hunted on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ooh, look at her run.|Ratter, observing Lika's agility and jumping skills, moments before Sochek kills her|<ref name="PL" />}}
Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Lika was captured by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters and along with other prisoners, including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], she was transported to a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] where they were to be hunted down for sport. Lika was dumped out of the [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|Trandoshan cruiser]] at night and managed to survive the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, fired by the Trandoshans. However, the next day, she met her fate when she, along with another prisoner [[Katt Mol/Legends|Katt Mol]] were walking along the jungle. Suddenly, a Trandoshan hunter [[Ratter/Legends|Ratter]] fired at them, [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Katt Mol/Legends|Katt Mol]]. Lika tried to flee, jumping from tree to tree, but she was soon also killed by Ratter's partner, [[Sochek/Legends|Sochek]]. As Ahsoka went to help Lika, [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]] pulled her back to keep cover.
